generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. FY 2021-22 to 2025-26 certified/issued by the Chartered Accountant shall be submitted, along with compulsory active UDIN ID number. Achieved in at least One financial years minimum financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.5.00 LAKHS As mentioned in the bid document which is usually not less than the estimated cost under this contract

Each tenderer in his name should have in the last five year i.e, . FY 2021-22 to 2025-26. Mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor at least executed Similar nature of work that is construction pipeline work pump motor work extend of the cost 25 percentage of the cost of the work Rs.10.00 Lakhs i.e 5.00 Lakhs As mentioned in the bid document obtained from Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent

Unconditional Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30 percentage of Amount put to tender Rs.10.00 Lakhs i.e 3.00 Lakhs As mentioned the bid document from nationalized bank or scheduled bank Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement Etc in the prescribed format enclosed
Information on Existing commitments and ongoing works which are yet to be completed
Contractor has to produce Bid Capacity on letter head duly signed
